title: State Convergence
statementMarkdown:
Four relays couple input to output at different ratios:

$$\frac{3}{7}, \quad \frac{5}{11}, \quad \frac{7}{15}, \quad \frac{9}{19}$$

The grid converges on whichever relay carries the **strongest coupling** (largest ratio).

**Which relay wins?**
hints: Compare pairwise by cross-multiplication instead of dividing.
